newsitem.title: USA: Green Tree Financial buys Finova division.
newsitem.headline: Green Tree Financial buys Finova division.

text.p: Green Tree Financial Corp said Monday it completed its purchase of the Manufacturer and Dealer Services unit of Finova Group Inc for an undisclosed price.
The newly acquired business provides vendor-oriented sales finance programs for small business equipment purchasers. It will be known as Green Tree Vendor Services Corp, said Green Tree Financial.
Green Tree Financial is a financial services company with a loan portfolio of $18 billion. The company serves consumer, manufactured housing, home improvement and commercial clients.
